verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a managed SaaS streaming service, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is that IVS emits events and you can create rules on them, but the rules and triggers run in Amazon EventBridge. That is a host-platform capability, not an automation feature IVS itself provides, so it earns no credit. Recording to S3 is a separate feature and does not show user-configured autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
